dedupe_keys.name: agwa automated geospatial watershed assessment with kineros2 and the agwa urban tool

description: AGWA is a GIS-based hydrologic modelling tool that uses commonly available GIS layers to parameterise, run and visualise watershed runoff and erosion models, and its AGWA Urban tool applies the KINEROS2 model to urban hydrology and green infrastructure. It covers small watersheds to basins, supporting KINEROS2, RHEM and SWAT; KINEROS2 includes an urban element with nine overland flow components for built land cover, and the AGWA Urban paper validated it on a residential subdivision in Arizona and compared retention basins, permeable driveways and rainwater harvesting cisterns. It was developed from the early 2000s by the USDA-ARS Southwest Watershed Research Center with the US EPA Office of Research and Development, the University of Arizona and the University of Wyoming; AGWApro 0.5 Beta for ArcGIS Pro is maintained as Python code on GitHub. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC0-1.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: AGWA runs inside Esri ArcGIS software, and KINEROS2 is event oriented. It supports runoff and flood analysis of green infrastructure scenarios, post-fire watershed assessment and climate adaptation planning; a related record is the GIFMod green infrastructure model.
